method: per-region PMI over has_ingredient, scored by lift against corpus PMI
source: our own corpus only - no third-party data
scope_filter: cuisine_scope == 'indian' only. Excludes indian-adapted, non-indian and indo-fusion, which otherwise surface as spurious regional signal (e.g. 'West Bengal: egg + ketchup', an Indo-Chinese dish carrying a Bengali region label).
note: lift_vs_all is the regional signal: how much MORE characteristic a pair is here than nationally. A molecular pairing database cannot express this, because a compound profile does not vary by region.
